about: Edson is a town in west-central Alberta on the Yellowhead Highway, roughly midway between Edmonton and Jasper. Coal, forestry, and highway-service roles define this working town on the McLeod River highland. About 8,000 people live in Edson.
seoSummary: Yellowhead Highway town between Edmonton and Jasper—coal, forestry, and highland service centre.
